salt-grain.name: quantcore-circuits
salt-grain.title: Quantcore Circuits
salt-grain.doc: KLayout front end of quantcore-circuits (pip install quantcore-circuits): open and live-rebuild a design.json, place components, connect ports with routes, hang readout resonators off feedlines, move and snap instances port to port, check the design (DRC), run the lumped-circuit model (LOM), export simulation jobs and fab files, and show the values beside each instance. The GUI only edits design.json; the qcc command builds the layout. Tool structure derived from KQCircuits' edit_node_plugin.py (GPL-3.0).
salt-grain.author: Quantcore
